topics.title: Document ingest pipeline
topics.summary: Documents are hashed, security-scanned, deduplicated and preflighted before compilation.

topics.title: Source traceability
topics.summary: Every compiled answer names the source blocks it was built from.

claims.text: Every AI-derived factual claim carries at least one source block identifier.

evidence.quote: AI-derived factual content requires valid source block evidence.

claims.text: Pages are preflighted after compilation completes.
A new world state is published atomically: readers see either the previous world or the new one, never a partial mix.

evidence.quote: 새 world state는 원자적으로 publish한다. 부분 성공 state를 agent가 보지 못하게 한다.
